title: VTN Listings — Create — payload
description: An administrator's instruction to list a community or network. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

did.description: The DID of the community or network to list. Never the network's own.

kind.description: What is listed; carried in the listing credential as `nodeType` `VTC` or `VTN` (VTI-VTN-031).

Response.title: VTN Listings — Create — response payload
Response.description: The new entry as the network's administrators see it: state `listed`, with the signed listing credential and the unsigned membership offer.
